Messages.Author: James Lin
Messages.Body:
Bon jour Reyda,

No, I'll never quit this wonderful game that I played since 1993. I have 30 decks and that's enough to play games with, I think. I have to sell the rest of my collection because I'll most likely have to move to Taiwan to take care of my ailing folks (my mom has dementia). I doubt I can carry the collection to Taiwan without having to cough up a lot of money. Therefore I'm selling the ones that's worth money on EBay. The ones that aren't worth much (like $1 or so) I will put up the list and sell them for like $0.05 - $0.20 so hopefully new players can buy them for cheap and build decent decks. I know Asia just had their first Asian championship, but I don't know if they need my collection. I'll definitely see you in June and you can get to see some of my new fun decks (do not confuse them with tournament quality decks, I rarely have those).

James
